company.name: Virtualmin
company.shortDescription: Virtualmin is a web hosting control panel for Linux and Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) systems.
company.description: Virtualmin is taking on the lack of innovation in the server admin programs, like Plesk, by making a more accessable version for pages managed by the non-technical crowd. The program will feature simple installs of popular programs like content management systems that often cost extra on other providers. It will also let you administer your website from your desktop and mobile device.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source web hosting control panel for Linux and BSD systems that manages domains, DNS, mail, databases, and security features.
productsAndServices.name: Virtualmin GPL

productsAndServices.description: A paid version of Virtualmin offering additional features like reseller accounts, advanced user management, multi-provider SSL support, and extended cloud storage integration.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud computing management platform for managing virtual machines and cloud accounts across multiple virtualization types and cloud providers.
